comparison.objective: Choose a regulation-compliant joist drilling location and place a guide there; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Rule-based spatial selection, guide placement and release versus small-tool manipulation, rotary tuning, locking and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Body uses binary compliance with centerline, span-zone and hole-spacing rules; no complete spec version is present. Candidate uses measured physical performance over two cycles.
comparison.reason: The tested competence is code-constrained placement, not force or mechanism adjustment.
